newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures at a standstill pre-weekend.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures at a standstill pre-weekend.

text.p: July 25 - U.S. debt futures were down slightly in stagnant pre-weekend trade. Euro broker said virtually no locals in the pit, few featured trades. Market on hold before ECI, GDP and jobs next week. "It should be an active week," one trader said. Sept T-bond resistance at 115-23, 116-00 and 116-28/32. Support at 115-00 to 115-02/32, traders said.
